subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 4: Book club – The platypus (a folk tale)
outcomes: Answer questions about the folk tale The platypus.
Understand the message of the story.

tf.s: A folk tale is an old story that teaches important things.
The platypus has fur and a beak, lays eggs and swims.
tf.why: Yes, she is like many groups.

tf.s: The platypus joins the birds at the end of the story.
The platypus can't bite like the lions because she doesn't have teeth.
The platypus can breathe underwater like the fish.
The message of the story is that everyone is special in different ways.
The noun from dive is diver.
The noun from swim is swimer.
The platypus can't join the birds because she can't fly.
tf.why: Yes, birds can fly but she can't.

tf.s: The lions say they are important because they have feathers.
tf.why: They say they have fur and can run.

boxes.q: What is the noun from write?
What is the noun from swim?
What is the noun from sing?
What is the noun from run?
Which group does the platypus join?
Which animals have beaks and lay eggs in the story?
boxes.why: The birds have beaks and lay eggs.

boxes.q: What does the platypus NOT have?
What can't the platypus do like the fish?
boxes.why: She can swim but can't breathe underwater.

boxes.q: What do the lions say makes them important?
boxes.why: They have fur and can run.

o: an old story that teaches something

mcq.q: Which group does the platypus join in the end?
o: None – she doesn't join any group.
mcq.why: She is special in her own way.

mcq.q: What is the message of the story?
o: Everyone is special in different ways.
mcq.why: The platypus is happy to be herself.

mcq.q: What is the noun from dive?
Which features does the platypus have?
o: fur, a beak, she lays eggs and swims
mcq.why: She has features of many groups.

mcq.q: Answer in a complete sentence: Why can't the platypus join the birds?
o: She can't join the birds because she can't fly.
mcq.why: A complete sentence repeats the question words.

mcq.q: Which sentence might the frogs say to the platypus?
o: If you join us, you can live on land and in water like us.
If you join us, you can fly high.
If you join us, you will have a hump.
If you join us, you will have feathers.
mcq.why: Frogs live on land and in water.

mcq.q: Why can't the platypus bite like the lions?
o: She has a beak like a lion.
mcq.why: Lions bite with teeth; the platypus has none.

mcq.q: Why did the platypus curl up and go to sleep?
o: She decided she was special in her own way and didn't want to join any group.
mcq.why: She is happy to be different.

mcq.q: Why does every animal group want the platypus?
o: She has something in common with each group.
mcq.why: Fur like lions, a beak and eggs like birds, swimming like fish.
